incident_title: B2B portal down: database disk full
content: Distributors report that the B2B portal is unreachable. The first calls came in at 07:50 and orders cannot be placed.

incident_title: B2B portal down: database disk full
content: Confirmed for all distributors: the portal is down, not slow. Raising the severity to critical.

incident_title: B2B portal down: database disk full
content: Infrastructure and the database team are on it. The portal database PAR-DB-01 is the first suspect.

incident_title: B2B portal down: database disk full
content: PAR-DB-01 is at 100% disk and PostgreSQL accepts no writes. The WAL archive job has been failing since 27 May; its target path changed during the SAN migration.

incident_title: B2B portal down: database disk full
content: Archive target corrected and the WAL backlog is being archived. Disk usage is falling. The portal stays read-only until the database is stable.

incident_title: B2B portal down: database disk full
content: Database writable again and the portal is open to distributors. About 140 orders were taken by phone and are being keyed in.

incident_title: SAP month-end close slowed down by host memory contention
content: Month-end close jobs are running about four times slower than usual. Finance cannot start the first consolidation run.

incident_title: SAP month-end close slowed down by host memory contention
content: Host memory contention confirmed on PAR-ESX-01 after the 29 April maintenance. Both SAP production VMs are on the host and the close is affected for all finance users. Raising to major.

incident_title: SAP month-end close slowed down by host memory contention
content: VMware and SAP Basis are engaged. Moving the BW VM to PAR-ESX-02 and checking the memory reservations.

incident_title: SAP month-end close slowed down by host memory contention
content: BW VM moved and the host memory pressure is gone. Close jobs are running at normal speed again.

incident_title: SAP month-end close slowed down by host memory contention
content: Close completed without data loss. Keeping the host under watch until after the weekend.

incident_title: SAP month-end close slowed down by host memory contention
content: Close reviewed with Finance: all figures are complete and posted once. No correction was needed.

incident_title: Lab results cannot be saved in QualityLab LIMS
content: QualityLab refuses to save results since about 10:00. The lab has switched to paper for new results.

incident_title: Lab results cannot be saved in QualityLab LIMS
content: All result entry is blocked for the Quality team. Raising the severity to major.

incident_title: Lab results cannot be saved in QualityLab LIMS
content: Application team and the DBA are investigating. The database size is the first lead.

incident_title: Lab results cannot be saved in QualityLab LIMS
content: Confirmed: the embedded SQL Server 2017 Express database reached its 10 GB limit. Results stay on paper while we plan the move to the SQL Server cluster.

incident_title: Lab results cannot be saved in QualityLab LIMS
content: Paper records are complete for yesterday. Batch release is delayed by about half a day; no result is lost.

incident_title: Lab results cannot be saved in QualityLab LIMS
content: Root cause still under investigation. Result history and audit tables are the main growth; the vendor case is open and a migration window is being planned.

incident_title: Lab results cannot be saved in QualityLab LIMS
content: No change over the weekend; the paper workaround is stable. The incident stays in progress until the database is moved.
